sealed.speaker: kojo
sealed.text: That's it. That's my phone. Dead as a stone — and still mine.

switched-on.speaker: kojo
switched-on.text: That's it… but it's been charged. Somebody switched it on.

choices.text: Nii charged it, to check it still worked.
It was like that when I found it.

honest.speaker: kojo
honest.text: Nii. I don't know him. …Next time, ask me first.

bright-called.speaker: kojo
bright-called.text: Uncle Bright called me. He says you told him the phone was yours.

choices.text: He wasn't going to hand it over otherwise.
Sorry. That was stupid of me.

tag.speaker: kojo
tag.text: "Received from Registry, Administration Block." So that's where it went. Two years, and nobody called me.

choices.text: If there's anything else of yours in that room, I'll keep it safe.
Kojo — why did you really leave UCIS?
Glad I could help. Take care.

offer.speaker: kojo
offer.text: Anything else… If you ever find anything of mine — anything — don't take it to Admin. Not to anybody. Keep it, and tell me.

number.speaker: kojo
number.text: Here — take my number. In case. Thank you, {name}. Really.

bye.speaker: kojo
bye.text: Thank you. I'll… see you around.
